_meta.description: Chunking sweep: force smaller, more numerous chunks by lowering the split threshold well below the structural item sizes.
_meta.hypothesis: Smaller chunks raise context precision (less irrelevant text per retrieved chunk) but may lower recall for multi-fact items like a full <entry>, because one experience entry now spans several chunks and only some are retrieved.
_meta.note: This changes the index fingerprint, so scripts/ingest.py must be re-run for this config before scripts/run_eval.py.

run.notes: Smaller chunks, wider k to compensate for fragmentation.
